targets.title: Crosslinguistic influence on L2 implicature computation for determiners.
targets.evidence_quote: Replicating Cho (2022), the present study examined the role of learning contexts in the computation of the implication of contrast by L1-Thai EFL (English as a Foreign Language) and ESL (English as a Second Language) speakers.
targets.outcome_quote: Results from an acceptability judgment task revealed that, unlike L1-English speakers, both L1-Thai EFL and ESL learners did not compute the implication of contrast, corroborating the original study and revealing no significant effect of naturalistic exposure on the computation of CIs.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract explicitly says the new-sample result corroborates the original lack of contrast-implicature computation. Failure of the extension prediction about naturalistic exposure is separate from agreement with the original.
